hud.dbzenith.powering_hint: a hard hit breaks it - master the form to 75%% to transform at once
message.dbzenith.no_transfer_target: Look at a player to give them ki
message.dbzenith.chamber_rest: The chamber needs rest before another stay (about %s min)
message.dbzenith.family_taken: One of you already has a partner
message.dbzenith.family_no_proposal: No proposal to accept (it lasts a minute)
screen.dbzenith.temperature.cold: cold (wear a chestplate or stand by a fire)
screen.dbzenith.life_single: Partner: none (give someone a Promise Ring)
message.dbzenith.fusion_not_beaten: Beat the warrior first (25%% health or less)
message.dbzenith.fusion_needs_namekian: Look at a beaten Namekian Warrior or a Namekian player
message.dbzenith.fused_warrior: The warrior becomes part of you: +%s attribute points (STR, CON, KI POWER, SPI)
message.dbzenith.fusion_request: %s asks you to fuse with them. You would become part of them and your character would start over.
message.dbzenith.fusion_no_request: No fusion request to accept (it lasts 30 seconds; stay close)
message.dbzenith.fused_into: You have become part of %s. Create a new character.
message.dbzenith.absorb_not_beaten: Beat it first (25%% health or less)
death.attack.dbzenith.throw.player: %1$s was thrown into the ground by %2$s
form.dbzenith.problem.race: Your race cannot use this form
form.dbzenith.problem.trigger: This form cannot be entered at will
form.dbzenith.problem.flag.god_ki: Requires godly ki (the ritual quest or a wish)
form.dbzenith.problem.god_ki: Requires god ki level %s (grow it in god forms)
message.dbzenith.form_exhausted: Out of ki: you drop out of your form
screen.dbzenith.current_form: Current: %s  (click a form to make it your transform target)
screen.dbzenith.no_forms: Your race has no forms yet (coming in Phase 3).
screen.dbzenith.kaioken_info: O: Kaioken (up to x%s)    Shift+O: release
screen.dbzenith.kaioken_unlearned: Kaioken: learn it on the Universal skills tab (Shift+I)
screen.dbzenith.form_keys: J: transform    Shift+J: revert one form
message.dbzenith.great_ape: The moon... you lose yourself to the Great Ape!
message.dbzenith.great_ape_end: The moonlight fades. You collapse, exhausted.
message.dbzenith.zenkai: Zenkai! Surviving that made you stronger.
form.dbzenith.problem.flag.potential_unl: Requires your potential to be unlocked (Elder, Phase 4)
race.dbzenith.human.desc: Versatile and quick to learn. +15% TP gain, techniques cost 15% less ki. Forms: Full Power, Buffed, Potential Unleashed. Racial: Solar Flare.
race.dbzenith.saiyan.desc: Born fighters with a tail. Cheap STR and Ki Power. Zenkai: recovering from near death makes you permanently stronger. Super Saiyan line and the Great Ape. Racial: Crimson Beam.
race.dbzenith.half_saiyan.desc: Balanced, smart and hidden potential. Smaller Zenkai, +5% TP gain, tail. Super Saiyan line plus Ultimate. Racial: Twin Wave.
race.dbzenith.namekian.desc: Regenerate three times faster, even soon after being hit. Cheap Spirit and Ki Power. Forms: Giant, Super and Orange Namekian. Racial: Regenerate.
race.dbzenith.frost_demon.desc: Born suppressed; each form releases more power. Need no air. Cheap DEX and Ki Power. Forms: Second, Third, Final, Golden. Racial: Supernova Orb.
race.dbzenith.majin.desc: Rubbery body that regenerates five times faster; kills restore 15% body. Cheap Constitution. Forms: Evil, Super, Pure Majin. Racial: Candy Beam.
race.dbzenith.android.desc: Never hungry, never tired, double ki regeneration, absorbs 30% of ki attacks as ki. Upgrades instead of forms. Racial: Energy Absorb.
race.dbzenith.cyborg.desc: Part machine: slow hunger, double stamina regen, absorbs 15% of ki attacks. Forms: Overclock, Full Conversion, Machine Mutant. Racial: Arm Cannon.
technique.dbzenith.ki_sense.desc: Feel every life force within 48 blocks: they glow, and you learn the strongest power levels.
technique.dbzenith.rapid_volley.desc: A spray of six small blasts.
technique.dbzenith.homing_orb.desc: A slow orb that curves toward its target.
technique.dbzenith.instant_step.desc: Vanish and reappear up to 10 blocks ahead.
technique.dbzenith.cutter_disk.desc: A spinning disk that slices through up to four enemies.
technique.dbzenith.explosive_wave.desc: Release ki in every direction, blasting everything within 5 blocks.
technique.dbzenith.wave_beam.desc: A sustained beam that follows your aim and explodes on impact.
technique.dbzenith.ki_heal.desc: Heal the player you look at (or yourself) by 20%.
technique.dbzenith.ki_transfer.desc: Give your ki to the player you look at. Spirit raises how much.
technique.dbzenith.grab_throw.desc: Grab the creature or player in front of you; use again to throw it. It takes damage when it lands. Bosses are too big.
technique.dbzenith.paralysis_wave.desc: A crackling wave that stuns everything in front of you for a moment.
technique.dbzenith.seal_orb.desc: An orb that seals the target's ki: no techniques, flight, charging or transforming for 5 seconds.
technique.dbzenith.gathering_sphere.desc: Gather a giant sphere above your head, then hurl it where you look. Huge damage, slow to form.
technique.dbzenith.namekian_fusion.desc: Fuse with a beaten Namekian Warrior, or a Namekian player who agrees, and gain their strength. Up to 3 times.
technique.dbzenith.majin_absorb.desc: Absorb a beaten foe (not a boss): +10%% power per foe for 10 minutes, and a technique from players.
technique.dbzenith.solar_flare.desc: A blinding flash: everything in front of you is blinded and slowed.
technique.dbzenith.crimson_beam.desc: A violet Saiyan beam, stronger than the Wave Beam.
technique.dbzenith.twin_wave.desc: A wide beam drawing on both heritages.
technique.dbzenith.supernova_orb.desc: A huge, slow orb of destruction.
technique.dbzenith.energy_absorb.desc: For 3 seconds, ki attacks restore your ki instead of hurting you.
technique.dbzenith.arm_cannon.desc: A fast, hard-hitting blast from your arm.
message.dbzenith.cannot_learn: You cannot learn anything from this scroll
screen.dbzenith.techniques_help: Click: learn / equip.  Click a deck slot to remove.
screen.dbzenith.create_sub: Your race shapes your forms, techniques and how you train.
message.dbzenith.gravity_set: Gravity set to %sx (sneak + use to lower)
message.dbzenith.chamber_enter: You step into the Hyperbolic Time Chamber. Time flows differently here: training counts many times over.
message.dbzenith.chamber_exit: You step back into the world.
message.dbzenith.chamber_time_up: Your time in the chamber is up.
message.dbzenith.need_all_balls: Gather all seven Dragon Balls together (within 4 blocks) to summon the dragon.
message.dbzenith.dragon_summoned: The sky darkens... %s has summoned the Eternal Dragon!
message.dbzenith.wish_granted: Your wish has been granted, %s: %s. The Dragon Balls scatter across the world...
screen.dbzenith.wish: I am the Eternal Dragon. Speak your wish.
screen.dbzenith.wish_sub: I can grant you one wish.
wish.dbzenith.power.desc: Gain a large amount of training points.
wish.dbzenith.restoration.desc: Full health, body, ki and stamina; your tail grows back; all effects cleared.
wish.dbzenith.immortality.desc: For 30 minutes, nothing can take your last breath.
wish.dbzenith.hidden_potential.desc: Awakens the power sleeping inside you (unlocks Ultimate for Half-Saiyans).
wish.dbzenith.godly_ki.desc: Lets you sense and wield divine energy (unlocks God forms).
item.dbzenith.gi.set_bonus: Full set: STR %s, DEX %s, Ki Power %s, -%s%% damage taken
message.dbzenith.scouter_overload: The scouter can't take that reading. It shatters!
message.dbzenith.capsule_nested: A capsule can't hold another capsule.
screen.dbzenith.master_sub: "Every master was once a beginner. Show me what you can do."
quest.dbzenith.why.alignment: The Patrol only works with good fighters
quest.dbzenith.why.rank: Your Patrol rank is too low
message.dbzenith.patrol_promoted: The Galactic Patrol promotes you to %s!
quest.dbzenith.first_steps.desc: Train your body: spend TP on attributes (K) until you reach level 10.
quest.dbzenith.energy_within.desc: Before you can fight with ki you must feel it. Learn Ki Sense (K > Techniques).
quest.dbzenith.trial_by_combat.desc: Sproutlings have been raiding at night. Defeat five of them.
quest.dbzenith.weight_of_the_world.desc: Craft Training Weights and push yourself to level 100. Gravity Chambers help.
quest.dbzenith.beyond_limits.desc: Break through your limits and transform for the first time (J).
quest.dbzenith.the_wish.desc: Follow the Dragon Radar, gather all seven Dragon Balls and summon the Eternal Dragon.
quest.dbzenith.divine_ritual.desc: Reach level 1000 and meditate inside the Hyperbolic Time Chamber to awaken godly ki.
quest.dbzenith.bounty_soldiers.desc: Rogue soldiers are firing on civilians. Take down ten.
quest.dbzenith.bounty_androids.desc: Rogue androids have been spotted. Dismantle three. (Officer rank)
quest.dbzenith.bounty_tyrant.desc: Use a Tyrant Sigil to draw out the Tyrant Lord, then defeat him. (Inspector rank)
quest.dbzenith.bounty_brute.desc: Use a Rage Totem to call the Rampage Brute and stop it. (Inspector rank)
planet.dbzenith.namek.desc: A peaceful green world with blue-green seas. Raiders have been seen there.
planet.dbzenith.northern_planet.desc: A tiny world with ten times Earth's gravity. Perfect for training.
wish.dbzenith.eternal_youth.desc: Return to the prime of your life (age 20).
screen.dbzenith.prestige_confirm: Your attributes and TP start over. You keep your race, techniques, mastery and quests, and gain a permanent bonus (prestige %s: more TP from training and more power).
radial.dbzenith.transform.hint: Step up to your next form (or the one you targeted in Forms).
radial.dbzenith.fly.hint: Take off or land. Flight drains ki.
radial.dbzenith.stats.hint: Attributes, training points and your record.
radial.dbzenith.techniques.hint: Learn techniques and build your deck.
radial.dbzenith.life.hint: Scars, tattoos and your race's look.
hair.dbzenith.copied: Hair code copied to the clipboard
hair.dbzenith.bad_code: The clipboard holds no hair code
kicreator.dbzenith.name: Name
kicreator.dbzenith.kind.blast.desc: One concentrated shot. Reliable and quick to come back.
kicreator.dbzenith.kind.barrage.desc: A spray of smaller shots. Not all of them will land, but some always do.
kicreator.dbzenith.kind.beam.desc: A sustained wave held as long as it burns, damaging everything along it. Meets other beams in a struggle.
kicreator.dbzenith.kind.bomb.desc: A sphere gathered overhead, then thrown. Slow to form, devastating where it lands.
kicreator.dbzenith.kind.disk.desc: A spinning blade of ki that cuts through several enemies in a line.
kicreator.dbzenith.problem.slot: That slot is not open yet
settings.dbzenith.ui_style.desc: Zenith: ornate gold frames, gem corners, an animated backdrop. Classic: the original flat panels.
settings.dbzenith.hd_art.desc: High-detail bodies, outfits and faces (twice the resolution: muscle definition, lashes, iris highlights). Off for the classic pixel look.
settings.dbzenith.controls_help: Every Dragon Block Zenith key is in the "Dragon Block Zenith" section of the key bindings. Defaults: G charge, Left Alt guard (tap just before a hit to parry), R ki attack, Y next technique, H heavy, B dash, V fly, J transform (Shift+J power down), O Kaioken, U racial skill, I universal skill, K training, X action wheel.
settings.dbzenith.hud_scale.desc: Size of the portrait, bars and readouts in the top left.
settings.dbzenith.custom_hotbar.desc: Draw the hotbar as glass slots between golden clouds instead of the vanilla bar.
settings.dbzenith.hide_hearts.desc: Your Body bar already shows your health, so the hearts and armour bar are hidden.
settings.dbzenith.cut_in.desc: A slash of your aura colour with your portrait and the form's name when you transform.
settings.dbzenith.debug_stats.desc: Developer aid: every derived stat as plain numbers.
settings.dbzenith.aura_detail.desc: How many flame tongues an aura has. Lower it on slow machines or in crowded fights.
settings.dbzenith.first_person_aura.desc: Your aura burns in around the screen edge when you can't see yourself, plus transformation flashes.
settings.dbzenith.afterimages.desc: Fading copies of fighters left behind by dashes and full-speed flight.
settings.dbzenith.hitstop.desc: Fighters freeze for a few frames when a blow connects, so hits land with weight.
settings.dbzenith.screen_shake.desc: How hard the camera shakes from hits, explosions and landings. 0% turns it off.
settings.dbzenith.procedural_motion.desc: Bodies bank into flying turns, lean into climbs, dives and fast runs, and squash on hard landings.
settings.dbzenith.hair_physics.desc: Hair streams behind you as you run and fly, lifts as you fall, swings as you turn and flickers in an aura.
settings.dbzenith.fov_effects.desc: A quick zoom on heavy blows and a widening rush when you dash.
race.dbzenith.vampire.desc: Ageless predators of the night. Fast and hard to kill: they heal over time and feed on their foes. Racial: Blood Drain bites the nearest enemy and drinks back half the damage.
race.dbzenith.bio_android.desc: Engineered from the cells of the strongest fighters. Regenerates fast, needs no food or air, and evolves towards perfection. Racial: Perfect Barrier.
race.dbzenith.tuffle.desc: A brilliant people of science with a long memory for revenge. Train the mind faster than anyone; techniques cost less ki. Racial: Tuffle Cannon.
race.dbzenith.gen_alien.desc: One of countless peoples from across space, balanced in every way. Choose how your world shaped you. Racial: Chaos Barrage.
race.dbzenith.core_person.desc: Born in the core of the universe: a divine Kai or a Demon of the dark realm. Ki-rich and spiritually gifted. Racial: Divine Restore and Dark Seal.
variant.dbzenith.saiyan.desc: The warrior race as most know it: the Super Saiyan line, from the first golden awakening to the god forms.
variant.dbzenith.primal.desc: An older bloodline that never lost its tail. After Super Saiyan 3 it turns back to the ape: the Golden Ape, then Super Saiyan 4 and its Limit Breaker.
variant.dbzenith.legendary.desc: Born once in a thousand years. Wrathful, C-Type and Full Power forms whose power keeps rising the longer a fight goes on.
variant.dbzenith.legendary_primal.desc: The legend and the primal bloodline in one body: the Legendary Super Saiyan line, the Legendary Great Ape and Legendary Super Saiyan 4.
variant.dbzenith.half_saiyan.desc: Saiyan blood, human heart. At your first milestone you choose a path.
variant.dbzenith.new_generation.desc: Hidden potential fully unlocked: the Ultimate form and, beyond it, Beast Awakening.
variant.dbzenith.future_lineage.desc: Forged in a ruined future. The Super Saiyan line and the god form, crowned by Super Saiyan Rage.
variant.dbzenith.awakened_evolution.desc: The ape within answers: the Golden Ape and the Super Saiyan 4 line instead of the god forms.
variant.dbzenith.human.desc: Ingenuity and grit. At your first milestone you choose a path.
variant.dbzenith.ancient_hermit.desc: The way of the old masters: Surge, a calm power that keeps growing, and a godly Surge once you hold god ki.
variant.dbzenith.peak_human.desc: The body perfected: Buffed, then the No Ego Zone, and the Godly Ego Zone with god ki.
variant.dbzenith.triclops.desc: The third eye opens: the Inner Eye, the Awakened Eye, and the Godly Eye that needs no ki to hold.
variant.dbzenith.warrior_clan.desc: Namekians bred for battle: Giant, Super and Orange Namekian, ending in the Namekian Warlord.
variant.dbzenith.dragon_clan.desc: Keepers of wishes and healing: the Dragon Sage and the Dragon Clan's awakened form.
variant.dbzenith.demon_clan.desc: Namekians who embraced their darker half: the Demon Namekian and the Demon King.
variant.dbzenith.frost_demon.desc: Born suppressed; each form sheds a shell, up to the Golden form.
variant.dbzenith.metal.desc: Rebuilt in alloy. A mechanical line of its own: Metal Shell, Overclock and the God Core.
variant.dbzenith.mutant.desc: A mutation that appears once in a generation: the Mutant Overlord and the Mutant God, stronger than any Golden form.
variant.dbzenith.majin.desc: Gum-bodied and nearly unkillable; grows by absorbing others, up to the Primordial Majin.
variant.dbzenith.corrupted.desc: A Majin whose mind cracked: Pure Corruption grows terrifyingly strong with mastery, at the cost of sanity.
variant.dbzenith.noble_blood.desc: Old, refined vampire lines: composed, resilient, patient.
variant.dbzenith.feral_blood.desc: Wild hunters who never learned restraint. A blood-red aura and a hunger to match.
variant.dbzenith.apex_strain.desc: Grown to be the single perfect fighter.
variant.dbzenith.swarm_strain.desc: Cells that remember every fighter they touched: a bright green aura and a hive's instincts.
variant.dbzenith.scientist_caste.desc: Engineers and thinkers: the mind first, always.
variant.dbzenith.parasite_caste.desc: Tuffles who survived as living machines inside others. Never forget, never forgive.
variant.dbzenith.heavyworlder.desc: From a crushing high-gravity world: sturdy and strong.
variant.dbzenith.voidborn.desc: Born between stars, at home in the void. A deep blue aura.
variant.dbzenith.swiftkin.desc: From a world of predators, where only the fast survived.
variant.dbzenith.kai.desc: A divine guardian: Divine Focus, Kai Awakening, the Supreme Kai and the Grand Kai's mantle.
variant.dbzenith.demon.desc: A child of the demon realm: the Demon Mark, Dark Evolution, the Demon Lord and the Demon God.
technique.dbzenith.blood_drain.desc: Bite the nearest enemy in front of you and drink: half the damage comes back as body.
technique.dbzenith.perfect_barrier.desc: A dome of ki bursts outward, blasting everything around you away.
technique.dbzenith.tuffle_cannon.desc: A green engineered beam that detonates where it ends.
technique.dbzenith.chaos_barrage.desc: A wide, unpredictable spray of alien ki.
technique.dbzenith.divine_restore.desc: A Kai's blessing: heals the player you look at, or yourself.
technique.dbzenith.dark_seal.desc: A demonic orb that seals the ki of whoever it hits.
screen.dbzenith.path_sub: Your power has reached its first milestone. Choose how it grows. This choice is permanent.
message.dbzenith.destiny_awakens: Your blood awakens to its true destiny
message.dbzenith.path_chosen: You now walk the path of the %s.
screen.dbzenith.racial_sub: Skills unlock as your level grows (you are level %s). Click an active to put it on the Racial key (U).
screen.dbzenith.racial_help: Hover a skill to read it. Passives work on their own once unlocked; actives fire with the Racial key.
message.dbzenith.racial_none: No active racial skill unlocked yet
message.dbzenith.death_regeneration: Your body pulls itself back together!
message.dbzenith.reincarnation: You are reborn from your own life force!
racial.dbzenith.stat.ki_on_hit: of max ki restored per hit
racial.dbzenith.persistence.desc: Humans do not know when to quit. Beaten down, you take less from every blow.
racial.dbzenith.second_wind.desc: Once every ten minutes, dropping below 10%% body in a fight restores a third of your body and stamina.
racial.dbzenith.sheer_willpower.desc: Refuse to tire: for 20 seconds your stamina never runs out and your power rises.
racial.dbzenith.mentors_teaching.desc: The hermit's way: you learn faster and master forms sooner.
racial.dbzenith.no_wasted_motion.desc: Every movement honed: techniques cost less ki and you move faster.
racial.dbzenith.third_eye.desc: The eye sees the opening a stronger foe leaves. Your ki is sharper too.
racial.dbzenith.warrior_race.desc: Saiyans come alive in battle: all power rises while fighting.
racial.dbzenith.false_advantage.desc: Let them think you are holding nothing: you hit harder in base form.
racial.dbzenith.seasoned_warrior.desc: Every fight teaches: far more training points while fighting.
racial.dbzenith.prideful.desc: A Saiyan's pride: you hit harder against anyone stronger than you.
racial.dbzenith.saiyans_resolve.desc: Plant your feet: for 15 seconds you shrug off blows and cannot be knocked back.
racial.dbzenith.overflowing_power.desc: The legend's ki never stops rising: much faster ki regeneration.
racial.dbzenith.unstoppable_force.desc: Transformed, you barely move when struck.
racial.dbzenith.venting.desc: Let the excess out: a blast that hurls everything near away and restores stamina.
racial.dbzenith.escalating_power.desc: The longer the fight, the stronger you grow.
racial.dbzenith.primal_zenkai.desc: Your Zenkai boosts are half again as strong.
racial.dbzenith.primal_evolution.desc: Your body adapts to every form faster.
racial.dbzenith.unmatched_ferocity.desc: Savage strength, and more when cornered.
racial.dbzenith.roaring_evolution.desc: A primal roar that slows and weakens everything near you.
racial.dbzenith.shattering_the_limit.des: Break past your limits for 12 seconds, then pay for it while your body recovers.
racial.dbzenith.prodigy.desc: A natural: you earn more training points from everything.
racial.dbzenith.hidden_talent.desc: Forms come to you easily: much faster mastery.
racial.dbzenith.immeasurable_potential.d: Pushed to the brink, a hidden power answers.
racial.dbzenith.blazing_spirit.desc: Your spirit burns: ki floods back and your aura scorches anyone close.
racial.dbzenith.unlocked_potential.desc: Power without the hair: stronger in base form.
racial.dbzenith.time_hardened.desc: A hard future taught you to hit back harder the moment you are hit.
racial.dbzenith.beast_within.desc: Cornered, the ape in your blood takes over your fists.
racial.dbzenith.vacuum_breathing.desc: Frost Demons need no air: never drown or suffocate.
racial.dbzenith.perfect_control.desc: Not a drop of ki wasted: techniques cost less.
racial.dbzenith.extreme_tenacity.desc: Near death, you take far less.
racial.dbzenith.tyrants_glare.desc: One look freezes those in front of you and saps their stamina.
racial.dbzenith.sadistic_nature.desc: Every hit you land restores ki.
racial.dbzenith.ruthless_mind.desc: No mercy: much more damage against a weakened foe.
racial.dbzenith.long_awaited_100.desc: Finally at full power: stronger while transformed.
racial.dbzenith.metal_plating.desc: An armoured body: less damage from everything.
racial.dbzenith.auto_repair_core.desc: When the shell cracks, the core rebuilds it fast.
racial.dbzenith.limb_regeneration.desc: Every five seconds your body sheds poisons, slows and other ailments.
racial.dbzenith.namekian_resilience.desc: A tough people: less damage from everything.
racial.dbzenith.spirit_disruption.desc: Scatter the ki of everyone near you and slow them.
racial.dbzenith.reincarnation.desc: Once every thirty minutes, death only sends you back to a new start of life.
racial.dbzenith.warriors_vitality.desc: Fresh into battle, the warrior clan hits harder.
racial.dbzenith.dragon_blessing.desc: The dragon clan's gift: heal every ally near you, and yourself a little.
racial.dbzenith.demonic_regeneration.des: Wounded, your body knits itself at an unnatural speed.
racial.dbzenith.gum_body.desc: Fists sink in and bounce off: less damage from blows.
racial.dbzenith.elastic_monster.desc: You never take fall damage and knockback only half moves you.
racial.dbzenith.remote_absorb.desc: Pull ki out of whatever you look at, healing yourself.
racial.dbzenith.death_regeneration.desc: Once every ten minutes, a killing blow just splatters you back together.
racial.dbzenith.sycophantic_rage.desc: Hurt, the madness lends your fists strength.
racial.dbzenith.inner_madness.desc: The longer you fight, the less sane and the more powerful you become. Ki returns slower in a fight.
racial.dbzenith.mindless_gambit.desc: Throw away all defence for 15 seconds: hit much harder, get hit much harder.
racial.dbzenith.infinite_reactor.desc: A power source that never empties: faster ki regeneration.
racial.dbzenith.organic_core.desc: What is still flesh heals faster.
racial.dbzenith.self_repair.desc: Run repairs: restore a quarter of your body at once.
racial.dbzenith.overclock.desc: Run hot for 12 seconds: more power and speed, then no ki regeneration while you cool down.
racial.dbzenith.night_stalker.desc: The night belongs to you: much stronger in the dark hours.
racial.dbzenith.sun_scorn.desc: Feral blood hates the sun: weaker by day.
racial.dbzenith.aristocrats_poise.desc: Untouched and composed, you take less from every blow.
racial.dbzenith.feral_instinct.desc: Faster when the hunt is on.
racial.dbzenith.crimson_hunger.desc: Wounded, every blow drinks: you heal from the damage you deal.
racial.dbzenith.bat_swarm.desc: Burst into bats and tear through everything in front of you, blinding it.
racial.dbzenith.regenerating_cells.desc: A body built from the best cells: faster healing.
racial.dbzenith.apex_predator.desc: Smell weakness: more damage to a wounded foe.
racial.dbzenith.swarm_vigor.desc: The swarm moves faster when it fights.
racial.dbzenith.adaptive_cells.desc: Your cells learn from every hit: you take less for a while after being hit.
racial.dbzenith.cellular_absorption.desc: Grab the nearest foe and drink part of its body into yours.
racial.dbzenith.perfect_body.desc: Every form brings you closer to perfection.
racial.dbzenith.tactical_genius.desc: You study everything: more training points.
racial.dbzenith.parasite_link.desc: Your blows feed you: heal from the damage you deal.
racial.dbzenith.nano_repair.desc: Nanomachines patch you up and purge every ailment.
racial.dbzenith.revenge_protocol.desc: Damage triggers the revenge program: much stronger ki.
racial.dbzenith.system_scan.desc: Scan the area: everyone near glows for 20 seconds and you hit them harder.
racial.dbzenith.adaptive_biology.desc: A body built for any world heals a little faster.
racial.dbzenith.dense_body.desc: Raised under crushing gravity: less damage from everything.
racial.dbzenith.void_step.desc: Fold space and step ten blocks where you are looking.
racial.dbzenith.adrenal_surge.desc: Hurt, your body floods with adrenaline: much faster.
racial.dbzenith.seismic_stomp.desc: Stamp the ground and throw everything standing near you into the air.
racial.dbzenith.void_touched.desc: The void flows through your ki.
racial.dbzenith.blur.desc: Move too fast to follow for 8 seconds: much faster and harder to hit.
racial.dbzenith.divine_insight.desc: A Kai's ki is deep and calm: faster regeneration and stronger ki.
racial.dbzenith.sacred_barrier.desc: A holy barrier for 6 seconds: most damage simply does not reach you.
racial.dbzenith.demonic_pact.desc: Demons are stronger in the dark.
racial.dbzenith.otherworldly_body.desc: A body of the other world: ki attacks hurt you less.
racial.dbzenith.kai_mastery.desc: A Kai learns forms with divine patience: much faster mastery.
racial.dbzenith.demon_hunger.desc: In a fight, every blow feeds you.
racial.dbzenith.dark_aura.desc: For 15 seconds a dark aura weakens everyone near you and strengthens you.
screen.dbzenith.universal_help: Click a skill to see it and learn its next level. Kaioken has its own key (O); the rest fire with the Skill key.
screen.dbzenith.universal_sub: Any race can learn these with training points (you have %s). Click a learned active to put it on the Skill key (I).
screen.dbzenith.transmission_sub: Feel for a ki and go. You arrive right behind them.
screen.dbzenith.transmission_alone: You sense no one in this world. You can still go home.
skill.dbzenith.problem.racial: Racial skills come with your race
message.dbzenith.skill_none: No universal skill learned yet (Shift+I to browse)
message.dbzenith.kaioken_form: Kaioken only works in base form or a calm god form
message.dbzenith.kaioken_max: Your body cannot take more than Kaioken x%s yet
message.dbzenith.kaioken_weak: Too hurt to push the Kaioken
message.dbzenith.kaioken_gave_out: Your body gives out - the Kaioken fades
message.dbzenith.ki_sense_scan_locked: The scan needs Ki Sense level 3
message.dbzenith.gambit_not_yet: Only when you are below 25%% body
racial.dbzenith.ki_sense.desc: Feel ki. Lv1: a warning when a far stronger ki is near. Lv2: arrows for ki attacks flying at you. Lv3: use it to see every ki around you for 10s.
racial.dbzenith.kaioken.desc: Multiply your power by straining your body: O raises the stage (x2, x4, x10, x20 by level), Shift+O releases it. Burns body every second, more if Willpower lags Spirit. Base form or a calm god form.
racial.dbzenith.rising_charge.desc: Charge at least 2s, then fire a technique within 2s of letting go: up to +50%% damage at 5s charged.
racial.dbzenith.echo_strike.desc: Dodge a blow with an afterimage and you are already behind the attacker, striking back. Light, Weightless, then Phantom hit harder. Every 6s.
racial.dbzenith.spirit_shock.desc: A point-blank burst of spirit: stuns everything near you and breaks guards.
racial.dbzenith.ki_barrier.desc: A sphere of ki for 8s: ki attacks lose most of their force and blows are softened.
racial.dbzenith.desperate_gambit.desc: Below 25%% body, throw half your ki and all your stamina in: for 10s you hit far harder and cannot fall. Then your ki stops returning for a while.
racial.dbzenith.limit_break.desc: Push past 100%% for a minute (Half-Saiyans twice as far, the New Generation four times). Then your body is sealed weaker for two minutes.
racial.dbzenith.instant_transmission.des: Lock onto any ki you can sense in this world and appear right behind them, or go home.
settings.dbzenith.move.zhit.how: Attack within half a second of a dash: x1.5 and a long stun
settings.dbzenith.move.directional.how: Hold W, S, A or D as you release Heavy: rush, uppercut, hook
settings.dbzenith.move.sweep.how: Release Heavy while guarding: unblockable, knocks down
settings.dbzenith.move.chase.how: Dash right after a heavy launches someone (3 per combo)
settings.dbzenith.move.chase_counter.how: Raise your guard just as a chaser appears
settings.dbzenith.move.revenge.how: Dash while stunned: armoured counter-hit (10%% stamina)
settings.dbzenith.move.breaker.how: Shift+Dash while under attack: throws everyone off (2 charges)
settings.dbzenith.move.recover.how: Dash when launched to right yourself; when downed to roll up
settings.dbzenith.move.dodge.how: Dash while guarding: spot dodge, or side step with A or D
settings.dbzenith.move.clash.how: Swing in the same instant as your foe: both blows cancel
settings.dbzenith.move.downed.how: Floored by sweeps and spikes: half damage, no launches
kicreator.dbzenith.kind.laser.desc: A needle-thin line that is there almost before it is fired. Narrow, fast, hard to dodge.
kicreator.dbzenith.kind.wave.desc: A wide fan of ki that sweeps everything in front of you at close range.
kicreator.dbzenith.kind.nova.desc: Ki bursts out of your whole body, hitting everything around you at once.
kicreator.dbzenith.kind.rain.desc: Shots fall from high above onto the spot you look at. Good against crowds and the guarded.
kicreator.dbzenith.method.fired.desc: Thrown the moment you use it. Right-click to cycle back.
kicreator.dbzenith.method.charged.desc: Gathered first (over your head, or in your hands for beams): half again as strong and a little cheaper per damage, but everyone sees it coming.
kicreator.dbzenith.method.placed.desc: Set as a mine where you look. It waits up to ten seconds and goes off when anyone comes close.
kicreator.dbzenith.origin.hand.desc: From the palms: the balanced way.
kicreator.dbzenith.origin.eyes.desc: From the eyes: smaller and faster, a little weaker.
kicreator.dbzenith.origin.finger.desc: From a fingertip: small, fast and piercing, a little weaker.
kicreator.dbzenith.origin.body.desc: From the whole body (novas and waves).
kicreator.dbzenith.type.burning.desc: Sets what it hits on fire.
kicreator.dbzenith.type.freezing.desc: Chills what it hits: slowed and frosted over.
kicreator.dbzenith.type.shock.desc: Crackles through what it hits: a chance to stun.
kicreator.dbzenith.type.corrosive.desc: Eats at what it hits: weakened and poisoned.
kicreator.dbzenith.type.draining.desc: Feeds you: heals you for part of the damage.
kicreator.dbzenith.type.divine.desc: God ki: 10%% stronger. Needs godly ki.
kicreator.dbzenith.mod.homing.desc: Curves after the nearest foe in front of you.
kicreator.dbzenith.mod.split.desc: Bursts into three smaller shots when it hits.
kicreator.dbzenith.mod.bounce.desc: Ricochets off walls and the ground twice.
kicreator.dbzenith.mod.guided.desc: Follows your crosshair as it flies.
kicreator.dbzenith.mod.chain.desc: Leaps to two more foes nearby for half damage.
kicreator.dbzenith.mod.guard_break.desc: Tears a big chunk out of a raised guard.
kicreator.dbzenith.mod.stun.desc: Stuns what it hits for half a second.
kicreator.dbzenith.mod.rapid.desc: Comes back far sooner, hits a quarter softer.
kicreator.dbzenith.mod.efficient.desc: Costs a quarter less ki, hits a little softer.
screen.dbzenith.face_hint: Faces show on the generated bodies (pick a skin tone). Forms with eyes of their own make your irises glow; golden forms turn your brows gold too.
screen.dbzenith.face_needs_body: Pick a skin tone (or your race look) to see your face.
settings.dbzenith.hud_style.desc: Zenith: an ornate portrait frame that changes with your form, and animated energy bars. Classic: the original slanted bars. Minimal: thin bars and numbers, no portrait.
